But source xml:p:57 states hemolysis was <5% across the MIC-2MIC range, while the final records only a single <5% row at 1x MIC and no 2x MIC or explicit range row, so the toxicity conflict is not field-complete.

blocking_findings.reason: Current activity/toxicity finals are not publication-grade source-exhaustive. Independent comparison found that Figure 3 and Figure 4 are activity-bearing inhibition-circle source surfaces in the primary PDF/XML, but no activity record, exclusion, unresolved candidate, or table_coverage_review entry mentions xml:fig:3 or xml:fig:4. Separately, xml:p:57 reports hemolysis <5% over the MIC-2MIC range, but the final encodes only one <5% threshold row at 1x MIC and no 2x MIC or explicit range representation. This is a material omitted surface/field despite zero hard findings in the current strict acceptance artifact.
